I want to use the order relationship on WithBot \Nat, such as its preorder and WF properties. However, I also want to use Option functions such as Option.all, Option.seq, Option.bind, and Option.map. What is an idiomatic (or at least the least cumbersome) way to go about this?

Currently, I am having some trouble with e.g. instances due to a mix.
normally what I would do is use docs#WithBot and don't use the Option functions with it, instead use WithBot functions like docs#WithBot.map, docs#WithBot.unbotD
@Aaron Liu Thanks- How should I find the names? Or should I implement all, any, seq, bind with the above? Would be a bit sad for not being able to leverage existing lemmas.
